verses.original: Περὶ δὲ τῆς λογείας τῆς εἰς τοὺς ἁγίους ὥσπερ διέταξα ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῆς Γαλατίας οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ποιήσατε
verses.transliteration: Peri de tēs logeias tēs eis tous hagious hōsper dietaxa tais ekklēsiais tēs Galatias houtōs kai hymeis poiēsate
verses.literal: Now about the collection for the saints you are to do as I directed the churches of Galatia
verses.literalPt: ORA, quanto à coleta que se faz para os santos, fazei vós também o mesmo que ordenei às igrejas da Galácia.

verses.original: κατὰ μίαν σαββάτου ἕκαστος ὑμῶν παρ’ ἑαυτῷ τιθέτω θησαυρίζων ὅ¦τι ἐὰν εὐοδῶται ἵνα μὴ ὅταν ἔλθω τότε λογεῖαι γίνωνται
verses.transliteration: kata mian sabbatou hekastos hymōn par’ heautō tithetō thēsaurizōn ho¦ti ean euodōtai hina mē hotan elthō tote logeiai ginōntai
verses.literal: On the first day of every week each of you should set aside . . . a portion of his income saving it up . . . so that when I come no collections will be needed
verses.literalPt: No primeiro dia da semana cada um de vós ponha de parte o que puder ajuntar, conforme a sua prosperidade, para que não se façam as coletas quando eu chegar.

verses.original: ὅταν δὲ παραγένωμαι οὓς ἐὰν δοκιμάσητε δι’ ἐπιστολῶν τούτους πέμψω ἀπενεγκεῖν τὴν χάριν ὑμῶν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ
verses.transliteration: hotan de paragenōmai hous ean dokimasēte di’ epistolōn toutous pempsō apenenkein tēn charin hymōn eis Ierousalēm
verses.literal: Then on my arrival I will send letters with those . . . you recommend to carry your gift to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E, quando tiver chegado, mandarei os que por cartas aprovardes, para levar a vossa dádiva a Jerusalém.

verses.original: ἐὰν δὲ ἄξιον ᾖ τοῦ κἀμὲ πορεύεσθαι σὺν ἐμοὶ πορεύσονται
verses.transliteration: ean de axion ē tou kame poreuesthai syn emoi poreusontai
verses.literal: And if it is advisable for me to go also they can travel with me
verses.literalPt: E, se valer a pena que eu também vá, irão comigo.

verses.original: Ἐλεύσομαι δὲ πρὸς ὑμᾶς ὅταν Μακεδονίαν διέλθω Μακεδονίαν γὰρ διέρχομαι
verses.transliteration: Eleusomai de pros hymas hotan Makedonian dielthō Makedonian gar dierchomai
verses.literal: After I go through Macedonia however I will come to you for I will be going through Macedonia
verses.literalPt: Irei, porém, ter convosco depois de ter passado pela Macedônia (porque tenho de passar pela Macedônia).

verses.original: πρὸς ὑμᾶς δὲ τυχὸν παραμενῶ ἢ καὶ παραχειμάσω ἵνα ὑμεῖς με προπέμψητε οὗ ἐὰν πορεύωμαι
verses.transliteration: pros hymas de tychon paramenō ē kai paracheimasō hina hymeis me propempsēte hou ean poreuōmai
verses.literal: Perhaps I will stay with you awhile or even spend the winter so that you can help me on my journey wherever I go
verses.literalPt: E bem pode ser que fique convosco, e passe também o inverno, para que me acompanheis aonde quer que eu for.

verses.original: οὐ θέλω γὰρ ὑμᾶς ἄρτι ἐν παρόδῳ ἰδεῖν ἐλπίζω γὰρ χρόνον τινὰ ἐπιμεῖναι πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐὰν ὁ Κύριος ἐπιτρέψῃ
verses.transliteration: ou thelō gar hymas arti en parodō idein elpizō gar chronon tina epimeinai pros hymas ean ho Kyrios epitrepsē
verses.literal: For I do not want to see you now only in passing I hope to spend some time with you if the Lord permits
verses.literalPt: Porque não vos quero agora ver de passagem, mas espero ficar convosco algum tempo, se o Senhor o permitir.

verses.original: ἐπιμενῶ δὲ ἐν Ἐφέσῳ ἕως τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς
verses.transliteration: epimenō de en Ephesō heōs tēs Pentēkostēs
verses.literal: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost
verses.literalPt: Ficarei, porém, em Éfeso até ao Pentecostes;

verses.original: θύρα γάρ μοι ἀνέῳγεν μεγάλη καὶ ἐνεργής καὶ ἀντικείμενοι πολλοί
verses.transliteration: thyra gar moi aneōgen megalē kai energēs kai antikeimenoi polloi
verses.literal: because a great door for effective work has opened to me even though many oppose me
verses.literalPt: Porque uma porta grande e eficaz se me abriu; e há muitos adversários.

verses.original: Ἐὰν δὲ ἔλθῃ Τιμόθεος βλέπετε ἵνα ἀφόβως γένηται πρὸς ὑμᾶς τὸ γὰρ ἔργον Κυρίου ἐργάζεται ὡς κἀγώ
verses.transliteration: Ean de elthē Timotheos blepete hina aphobōs genētai pros hymas to gar ergon Kyriou ergazetai hōs kagō
verses.literal: If Timothy comes see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you for he is doing the work of the Lord just as I am
verses.literalPt: E, se Timóteo for, vede que esteja sem temor convosco; porque trabalha na obra do Senhor, como eu também.

verses.original: μή τις οὖν αὐτὸν ἐξουθενήσῃ προπέμψατε δὲ αὐτὸν ἐν εἰρήνῃ ἵνα ἔλθῃ πρός με ἐκδέχομαι γὰρ αὐτὸν μετὰ τῶν ἀδελφῶν
verses.transliteration: mē tis oun auton exouthenēsē propempsate de auton en eirēnē hina elthē pros me ekdechomai gar auton meta tōn adelphōn
verses.literal: No one then should treat him with contempt . . . Send him on his way in peace so that he can return to me for I am expecting him along with the brothers
verses.literalPt: Portanto, ninguém o despreze, mas acompanhai-o em paz, para que venha ter comigo; pois o espero com os irmãos.

verses.original: Περὶ δὲ Ἀπολλῶ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ πολλὰ παρεκάλεσα αὐτὸν ἵνα ἔλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς μετὰ τῶν ἀδελφῶν καὶ πάντως οὐκ ἦν θέλημα ἵνα νῦν ἔλθῃ ἐλεύσεται δὲ ὅταν εὐκαιρήσῃ
verses.transliteration: Peri de Apollō tou adelphou polla parekalesa auton hina elthē pros hymas meta tōn adelphōn kai pantōs ouk ēn thelēma hina nyn elthē eleusetai de hotan eukairēsē
verses.literal: Now about our brother Apollos I strongly urged . . . him to go to you with the brothers He was not at all inclined to go now but he will go when he has the opportunity
verses.literalPt: E, acerca do irmão Apolo, roguei-lhe muito que fosse com os irmãos ter convosco, mas, na verdade, não teve vontade de ir agora; irá, porém, quando se lhe oferecer boa ocasião.

verses.original: Γρηγορεῖτε στήκετε ἐν τῇ πίστει ἀνδρίζεσθε κραταιοῦσθε
verses.transliteration: Grēgoreite stēkete en tē pistei andrizesthe krataiousthe
verses.literal: Be on the alert Stand firm in the faith Be men of courage Be strong
verses.literalPt: Vigiai, estai firmes na fé; portai-vos varonilmente, e fortalecei-vos.

verses.original: πάντα ὑμῶν ἐν ἀγάπῃ γινέσθω
verses.transliteration: panta hymōn en agapē ginesthō
verses.literal: Do everything in love
verses.literalPt: Todas as vossas coisas sejam feitas com amor.

verses.original: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί οἴδατε τὴν οἰκίαν Στεφανᾶ ὅτι ἐστὶν ἀπαρχὴ τῆς Ἀχαΐας καὶ εἰς διακονίαν τοῖς ἁγίοις ἔταξαν ἑαυτούς
verses.transliteration: Parakalō de hymas adelphoi oidate tēn oikian Stephana hoti estin aparchē tēs Achaias kai eis diakonian tois hagiois etaxan heautous
verses.literal: You know that Stephanas and his household were the first converts in Achaia and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints Now I urge you brothers
verses.literalPt: Agora vos rogo, irmãos (sabeis que a família de Estéfanas é as primícias da Acaia, e que se tem dedicado ao ministério dos santos),

verses.original: ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς ὑποτάσσησθε τοῖς τοιούτοις καὶ παντὶ τῷ συνεργοῦντι καὶ κοπιῶντι
verses.transliteration: hina kai hymeis hypotassēsthe tois toioutois kai panti tō synergounti kai kopiōnti
verses.literal: to - submit to such as these and to every fellow worker and laborer
verses.literalPt: Que também vos sujeiteis aos tais, e a todo aquele que auxilia na obra e trabalha.

verses.original: Χαίρω δὲ ἐπὶ τῇ παρουσίᾳ Στεφανᾶ καὶ Φορτουνάτου καὶ Ἀχαϊκοῦ ὅτι τὸ ὑμέτερον ὑστέρημα οὗτοι ἀνεπλήρωσαν
verses.transliteration: Chairō de epi tē parousia Stephana kai Phortounatou kai Achaikou hoti to hymeteron hysterēma houtoi aneplērōsan
verses.literal: I am glad that Stephanas Fortunatus and Achaicus have arrived because they have supplied what was lacking from you
verses.literalPt: Folgo, porém, com a vinda de Estéfanas, de Fortunato e de Acaico; porque estes supriram o que da vossa parte me faltava.

verses.original: ἀνέπαυσαν γὰρ τὸ ἐμὸν πνεῦμα καὶ τὸ ὑμῶν ἐπιγινώσκετε οὖν τοὺς τοιούτους
verses.transliteration: anepausan gar to emon pneuma kai to hymōn epiginōskete oun tous toioutous
verses.literal: For they refreshed my spirit and yours as well Show your appreciation therefore to such men
verses.literalPt: Porque recrearam o meu espírito e o vosso. Reconhecei, pois, aos tais.

verses.original: Ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς αἱ ἐκκλησίαι τῆς Ἀσίας Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς ἐν Κυρίῳ πολλὰ Ἀκύλας καὶ Πρίσκα σὺν τῇ κατ’ οἶκον αὐτῶν ἐκκλησίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Aspazontai hymas hai ekklēsiai tēs Asias Aspazetai hymas en Kyriō polla Akylas kai Priska syn tē kat’ oikon autōn ekklēsia
verses.literal: The churches in the province of Asia send you greetings . . . Aquila and Prisca greet you warmly in the Lord and so does the church that meets at their house
verses.literalPt: As igrejas da Ásia vos saúdam. Saúdam-vos afetuosamente no Senhor Áqüila e Priscila, com a igreja que está em sua casa.

verses.original: Ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς οἱ ἀδελφοὶ πάντες Ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν φιλήματι ἁγίῳ
verses.transliteration: Aspazontai hymas hoi adelphoi pantes Aspasasthe allēlous en philēmati hagiō
verses.literal: All the brothers here send you greetings . . . Greet one another with a holy kiss
verses.literalPt: Todos os irmãos vos saúdam. Saudai-vos uns aos outros com ósculo santo.

verses.original: Ὁ ἀσπασμὸς τῇ ἐμῇ χειρὶ Παύλου
verses.transliteration: Ho aspasmos tē emē cheiri Paulou
verses.literal: This greeting is in my own hand Paul
verses.literalPt: Saudação da minha própria mão, de Paulo.

verses.original: Εἴ τις οὐ φιλεῖ τὸν Κύριον ἤτω ἀνάθεμα Μαράνα θά
verses.transliteration: Ei tis ou philei ton Kyrion ētō anathema Marana tha
verses.literal: If anyone does not love the Lord let him be under a curse Come O Lord
verses.literalPt: Se alguém não ama ao Senhor Jesus Cristo, seja anátema. Maranata!

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ μεθ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Hē charis tou Kyriou Iēsou meth’ hymōn
verses.literal: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you
verses.literalPt: A graça do SENHOR Jesus Cristo seja convosco.

verses.original: Ἡ ἀγάπη μου μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ Ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: Hē agapē mou meta pantōn hymōn en Christō Iēsou Amēn
verses.literal: My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus Amen
verses.literalPt: O meu amor seja com todos vós em Cristo Jesus. Amém.
